description: This file defines the Zend_Http_Response class which models an HTTP response message, including properties for status code, headers, body, and methods for parsing, decoding, and inspecting HTTP responses.

classes.name: Zend_Http_Response
classes.description: Represents an HTTP response message with methods to access status, headers, body, and to perform parsing and decoding operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a Zend_Http_Response object, initializing status code, headers, body, version, and message.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Returns true if the response status code indicates an error (4xx or 5xx).

methods.name: isSuccessful
methods.description: Returns true if the response indicates success (status codes 1xx or 2xx).

methods.name: isRedirect
methods.description: Returns true if the response is a redirect (status code 3xx).

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Returns the response body, decoding transfer and content encodings as necessary.

methods.name: getRawBody
methods.description: Returns the raw, unprocessed response body.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the HTTP version string of the response.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Returns the status message associated with the response code.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Returns all response headers as an associative array.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Returns a specific header value or null if not set.

methods.name: getHeadersAsString
methods.description: Returns all headers as a formatted string.

methods.name: asString
methods.description: Returns the complete response as a formatted string, including headers and body.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Magic method to convert the response object to string using asString().
